c.v: Super watchdog (SWD) is an ultra-low-power circuit in analog domain that helps to prevent the system from operating in a sub-optimal state and resets the system if required.
SWD contains a watchdog circuit that needs to be fed for at least once during its timeout period, which is slightly less than one second.
before watchdog timeout, it will also send out a WD_INTR signal as a request to remind the system to feed the watchdog.
If the system doesn't respond to SWD feed request and watchdog finally times out, SWD will generate a system level signal SWD_RSTB to reset whole digital circuits on the chip.
